description: Calculate break cost for a lease. Use when you need a detailed breakdown of early termination costs. Do NOT use when comparing different lease options; use compare_options instead.

deposit.description: Initial deposit amount as a number

expected_relet_months.description: Expected months to relett the property as a number

landlord_mitigates.description: True if landlord mitigates damages, false otherwise

months_remaining.description: Months left on the lease (including the current one)

notice_months.description: Number of months' notice required to terminate the lease

reletting_fee.description: Fee for reletting the property as a number

name: estimate_break_cost

cost_breakdown.description: A detailed breakdown of the costs.

amount.description: The amount of the cost item.

description.description: A description of the cost item.

deposit_credit.description: The amount of deposit that will be returned.

reletting_fee.description: The fee charged by the landlord or agent for re-letting the property.
